parsed.notes: The Covenant Relief Period was terminated early on June 30, 2026, reducing the maximum secured net leverage ratio to 4.00x for the June 30 and September 30, 2026 test periods. The company states it was in compliance with its financial covenants at September 30, 2026. The $15 million minimum liquidity covenant ceased to apply after the relief period ended. The interest coverage actual is not disclosed. The Credit Agreement was repaid and terminated on October 21, 2026. Under the New Credit Agreement, the covenants are a secured net leverage ratio of at most 4.50x through June 30, 2027 (stepping down to 4.25x and then 4.00x) and a fixed charge coverage ratio of at least 1.20x; testing begins December 31, 2026, so these are not recorded as entries. The 3.75x secured net leverage figure in the Sixth Amendment is a restricted-payment condition, not a maintenance covenant. Earlier relief-period limits for 2025 test periods are omitted.
